package.description: The RS Games client is a revolutionary game client that allows people to play games against each other through a central server hosted by RS Games.

en-US.description: The RS Games client is a revolutionary game client that allows people to play games against each other through a central server hosted by RS Games.
en-US.longDescription: RS Games has developed online board, card, and dice games that are accessible to the blind and visually impaired. Over 20 games are currently available including Monopoly, Uno, Blackjack, Yahtzee, Farkle, and Scrabble.
en-US.name: RSGames Game Client
